title: Bounmy SENGMANY (father, holds the family phone)
description: Persona: Somsack's father, 29, head of the household in Lao PDR, who holds the family's one shared phone (J4). Goal: keep the whole family's health records in one place he controls. Needs one app for three people on one phone, to share records abroad without paperwork, and to decide who sees what and for how long. Frustrations: carrying folders of documents across the border; not knowing who has seen his child's data. Creates Somsack's passcode-protected VHL (J4.0) and says the passcode aloud at the clinic (J4.1). Fictional.
